gap: No result ChatGPT got states that neither of its two named products can be bought and plugged in by most US shoppers: EcoFlow says STREAM Ultra is sold and installed in Utah only, and Anker's Solarbank has no US listing. Outside Utah the battery option that works is an off-grid kit like the BLUETTI AC180 + 200 W at $769 on BLUETTI's US store today.
standout_why: ChatGPT's search returned no result pages, so there are no cited rival pages to compare against. Its answer named Anker SOLIX Solarbank and EcoFlow STREAM with no price, no state limits and no US availability. It gave only a general warning that wall-outlet solar 'is not automatically legal'. It never said that Solarbank isn't sold in the US or that STREAM Ultra is limited to Utah, and it named no option for the other states.
decides: It changes the pick. ChatGPT's two catalog cards fail most US shoppers: STREAM Ultra is Utah-only (EcoFlow) and Solarbank has no US listing (PlugAndSun, read by them 2026-10-25). Outside Utah the battery pick is an off-grid power station with a panel: BLUETTI AC180 + 200 W at $769 ($668/kWh), or Elite 200 V2 + 200 W at $1,199 ($578/kWh) for twice the storage. The grid-tied kits sold for plug-in-law states (Mango Power S at $2,499, Bright Saver at $432) come with no battery.
